verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents a few of its own isolation capabilities: Functions can be developed locally before deploying, Sites gives non-production branches preview links, and the platform can run as a local Docker instance, which a community member noted eases testing. The CLI can also create and manage separate projects, and migrations between Cloud and self-hosted are supported. However, the evidence shows no first-class sandbox or staging environment that isolates test data from production, so building one depends on the user arranging separate projects or instances. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment feature, isolation of test data from production data, data seeding or branching for test environments, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven testing against a sandbox.
